hooks.command: R=/mnt/project-files; if [ -f "$R/tools/hooks/dispatch.py" ]; then python3 "$R/tools/hooks/dispatch.py" pre-merge || exit 2; else echo 'Publish gate: this session cannot reach the Project Files folder, so the merge is refused. Merge from a cloud session in the project, or ask the Architect.' >&2; exit 2; fi

if grep -qE 'gh +pr +merge|git[^"]*[ ]push[^"&;|]*[ :](refs/heads/)?(main|master)([ "]|$)'; then echo 'Publish gate: merging or pushing to main from the command line skips the gate. Push to a branch and merge the pull request.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
